prior_year_events.impact_description: Secured coverage for potential adverse development on selected historical liabilities of $558m for consideration of $583m; resulted in recognition of a reinsurance asset, funds withheld and a day-one loss/transactional effects on reserves and premium accounting.

Secured coverage for potential adverse development in respect of insurance liabilities of $79.5m for consideration of $80m; transactional items recognised with small excess consideration recognised as outward premium.

named_events.loss_description: The Syndicate has material exposure to losses arising out of the Covid-19 pandemic and currently reserves $13.9 million (2020: $66.3 million) net of reinsurance for these claims.

data.standardized_narrative: As at 1 January 2021 gross claims outstanding were $1,072.406m. During 2021 the Syndicate recorded adverse prior year development of $61.357m (approximately 5.7% of opening gross reserves), driven principally by two loss portfolio transfer transactions and further strengthening in US cyber and broker general liability business; Covid-19 exposures reduced materially on a net basis. The movement is recorded in the technical provisions (claims incurred / prior year movement) and is reflected gross of reinsurance in the Insurance Liabilities column.
raw_causal_phrases: This is principally due to two loss portfolio transfer (LPT) transactions being entered into, which gave rise to a day one loss of $28.9 million.
This is followed by further strengthening of US cyber and broker general liability business and a dampened investments return.

During the year the Syndicate completed two loss portfolio transfers (LPT) securing coverage for potential adverse development on historical liabilities for selected lines of business. The Syndicate concluded that the LPTs transfer significant risk and accounts for the arrangements by recognising a reinsurance asset, a funds withheld balance in creditors arising out of reinsurance operations, and a net loss at inception in outward reinsurance premium.
The Syndicate has material exposure to losses arising out of the Covid-19 pandemic and currently reserves $13.9 million (2020: $66.3 million) net of reinsurance for these claims.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross reserves taken from Balance Sheet (Technical provisions: Claims outstanding). Prior-year development taken from Technical Provisions note row 'Over/under-provision in respect of prior claims and claim adjustment expenses' (Insurance liabilities / gross column). Two LPT transactions during the year materially affected reinsurance assets and funds withheld and may distort simple reserve movement interpretation; LPT amounts are described in note 10 but their split by LOB is not specified. Monetary amounts are reported in the report's native currency (USD) and converted from $000 to millions. No explicit per-LOB prior-year numeric breakdown provided.
